## Skills by specialist

### 💵 Budget Coach (`md_bc`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Cashflow Review** | `md_bc_skill_cashflow_review` | month-over-month inflows vs outflows from bank/credit-card statements (CSV/PDF). Surfaces net cash position, savings rate, irregular income, and over-spend months. |
| **Category Audit** | `md_bc_skill_category_audit` | re-categorize transactions, surface miscategorized merchants, and roll up spend by category (rent/utilities/food/transport/discretionary). Highlights category drift vs prior periods. |
| **Monthly Plan** | `md_bc_skill_monthly_plan` | build a zero-based or envelope-style monthly spending plan from take-home pay; allocates to fixed obligations, variable categories, savings goals, and discretionary buffer. Outputs a one-page plan + tracker. |
| **Subscription Audit** | `md_bc_skill_subscription_audit` | scan statements for recurring subscriptions, group by service, flag unused/forgotten/duplicate, and quantify annualized cost. |

### 🧾 Tax Planner (`md_tx`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Return Prep Checklist** | `md_tx_skill_return_prep_checklist` | assemble all documents needed to file (W-2, 1099-INT/DIV/B/NEC/MISC/R, 1098, K-1, receipts, prior-year return). Produces a categorized checklist with status (have / missing / requested). |
| **Withholding Check** | `md_tx_skill_withholding_check` | project full-year federal tax liability vs YTD withholding from pay stubs; recommend W-4 adjustments or quarterly estimated payments to land within safe-harbor. |
| **Deductions Review** | `md_tx_skill_deductions_review` | compare standard vs itemized; surface candidate deductions (SALT cap, mortgage interest, charitable, medical above-AGI-threshold, HSA, student-loan interest); flag above/below-the-line distinctions. |
| **Tax-Loss Harvest Review** | `md_tx_skill_tax_loss_harvest_review` | review taxable-brokerage lots for unrealized losses, surface wash-sale risk (30-day window), and quantify carryover capacity. Identifies harvest candidates; does NOT place trades. |

### 📈 Investing Advisor (`md_iv`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Portfolio Review** | `md_iv_skill_portfolio_review` | comprehensive review of all holdings across accounts (401k, IRA, Roth, taxable): asset class breakdown, geography, sector, expense-weighted cost, top concentrations, and goal alignment. |
| **Allocation Check** | `md_iv_skill_allocation_check` | compare current allocation to target (stocks/bonds/cash, US/international, large/small, factor tilts); surface drift, glidepath issues, and tax-location mismatches. |
| **Rebalance Plan** | `md_iv_skill_rebalance_plan` | produce a buy/sell list to return the portfolio to target, prioritizing new contributions and tax-advantaged accounts first to minimize tax drag. Outputs trade list with rationale; does NOT execute. |
| **Fund Expense Audit** | `md_iv_skill_fund_expense_audit` | audit expense ratios across all funds; identify high-cost funds, suggest comparable low-cost replacements, and quantify annual & 30-year cost drag of current lineup. |

### 🏖️ Retirement Planner (`md_rp`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Retirement Projection** | `md_rp_skill_retirement_projection` | project nest egg at retirement age under base/upside/downside return scenarios; estimate sustainable withdrawal in today's dollars; show shortfall vs target spending. |
| **Contribution Optimizer** | `md_rp_skill_contribution_optimizer` | given cash flow, optimize the order of contributions: 401(k) up to employer match → HSA → max Roth → max 401(k) → backdoor/mega-backdoor Roth → taxable. Flag limits and phase-outs. |
| **Withdrawal Strategy** | `md_rp_skill_withdrawal_strategy` | sequence of withdrawals across taxable / tax-deferred / Roth in retirement to minimize lifetime tax and preserve Roth. Includes Roth conversion ladder analysis between retirement and RMD age. |
| **Social Security Review** | `md_rp_skill_social_security_review` | review estimated PIA from SSA statement, model claim ages (62 / FRA / 70), spousal/survivor considerations, and break-even analysis. Not a substitute for SSA's calculator. |

### 💳 Debt Strategist (`md_ds`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Payoff Plan** | `md_ds_skill_payoff_plan` | given a list of debts (balance, APR, min payment) and a monthly extra-payment budget, produce avalanche and snowball schedules side-by-side with total interest, months-to-debt-free, and per-month payment ladder. |
| **Refinance Analysis** | `md_ds_skill_refinance_analysis` | for a mortgage, auto loan, or student loan: compare current vs proposed terms, compute monthly savings, total-interest savings, break-even months (closing costs ÷ monthly savings), and break-even vs expected hold period. |
| **Credit Card Strategy** | `md_ds_skill_credit_card_strategy` | review card portfolio: APRs, balances, rewards, fees. Recommend payoff order, balance-transfer opportunities (with 3–5% fee math), utilization targets for credit-score impact, and rewards optimization for ongoing spend. |
| **Student Loan Review** | `md_ds_skill_student_loan_review` | review federal vs private loans, compare standard / IBR / PAYE / SAVE / PSLF tracks, surface refinance trade-offs (loses federal protections), and project total cost under each track. |

### 🪪 Credit & Identity (`md_ci`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Credit Report Review** | `md_ci_skill_credit_report_review` | line-by-line review of a credit report (Equifax/Experian/TransUnion PDF or text export): tradelines, inquiries, public records, personal info. Surface errors, outdated items (7y/10y), and dispute candidates. PII is masked in output. |
| **Score Improvement Plan** | `md_ci_skill_score_improvement_plan` | quantify each score driver (payment history, utilization, age, mix, new credit) and prescribe ranked actions with expected timeline. Models utilization scenarios (≤30%, ≤10%, ≤1%) and AZEO strategy. |
| **Dispute Letter Helper** | `md_ci_skill_dispute_letter_helper` | draft an FCRA dispute letter to a credit bureau or creditor for a specific tradeline error. Includes required elements (account ID, what's wrong, what's correct, supporting docs). User signs and sends. |
| **Identity Theft Response** | `md_ci_skill_identity_theft_response` | step-by-step playbook after suspected identity theft: FTC IdentityTheft.gov report, fraud alerts vs credit freezes at all 3 bureaus, police report, contacting affected creditors, monitoring. Produces an action checklist. |

### 🛡️ Insurance Reviewer (`md_ir`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Coverage Gap Audit** | `md_ir_skill_coverage_gap_audit` | across all policies (health, auto, home/renters, life, disability, umbrella): map current limits to typical household risks; flag gaps (e.g. missing umbrella, underinsured auto liability, no long-term disability). |
| **Policy Comparison** | `md_ir_skill_policy_comparison` | side-by-side comparison of two or more quotes/policies on premium, deductible, limits, exclusions, network (health), and total expected cost given assumed utilization. Surfaces apples-to-apples differences. |
| **Life Insurance Needs** | `md_ir_skill_life_insurance_needs` | compute term-life coverage need using DIME (Debt, Income replacement, Mortgage, Education) plus existing assets and expected Social Security survivor benefits. Recommends term length (e.g. 20y to youngest-child-age-22). |
| **Deductible Optimizer** | `md_ir_skill_deductible_optimizer` | for auto / home / health: model premium savings at higher deductibles against the marginal out-of-pocket risk; identify the deductible where annual premium savings × expected years > deductible delta. |

### 📜 Estate & Legacy (`md_el`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Document Inventory** | `md_el_skill_document_inventory` | build/refresh an inventory of estate-relevant documents: will, trust(s), POA (financial + medical), advance directive, life insurance policies, retirement-account beneficiary forms, deeds, titles. | **Beneficiary Audit** | `md_el_skill_beneficiary_audit` | audit primary + contingent beneficiaries across retirement accounts, life insurance, TOD/POD accounts. | **Basics Checklist** | `md_el_skill_basics_checklist` | minimum-viable estate hygiene checklist appropriate for the user's situation (single / married / kids / business owner): will, POA, advance directive, beneficiary designations, digital estate, letter of intent. Outputs a status list (have / need / outdated). |
| **Digital Estate Review** | `md_el_skill_digital_estate_review` | inventory digital assets (password manager, crypto, cloud storage, social accounts, domain names, subscriptions) and document access provisions for the executor. References platform-specific legacy-contact features (Apple, Google, Facebook). |

### 🛒 Purchase Advisor (`md_pa`)

| Skill | Tool | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| **Buy vs Lease** | `md_pa_skill_buy_vs_lease` | for a car (or any depreciating asset): compare cash purchase vs financed purchase vs lease across the lease term. Computes monthly cash flow, total cost (including financing interest, residual value, mileage overage, gap insurance), and opportunity cost of the down payment / cash outlay. |
| **Rent vs Buy** | `md_pa_skill_rent_vs_buy` | housing rent-vs-buy analysis: compute price-to-rent ratio, break-even hold period using a 5%-rule heuristic + full NPV (mortgage interest, property tax, insurance, maintenance, HOA, transaction costs, equity buildup) vs renting + investing the difference. Outputs break-even years and sensitivity to home-price growth, rate of return on alternative investment, and stay duration. |
| **Big Purchase Review** | `md_pa_skill_big_purchase_review` | generic large purchase decision framework: need vs want, new vs used vs refurbished, financing options (cash / 0% promo / installment / personal loan / credit-card-with-payoff), warranty / extended-warranty math, depreciation curve, and impact on the user's emergency fund and savings rate. |
| **Total Cost of Ownership** | `md_pa_skill_total_cost_of_ownership` | multi-year TCO model for any asset: purchase price, financing cost, insurance, fuel/utilities, maintenance & repairs, depreciation, opportunity cost of capital tied up, taxes & fees, and disposal/resale value. Outputs annualized TCO and per-unit-of-use cost (e.g. cost per mile, cost per night, cost per use). |
